checklist.item: Riser height and tread depth are dimensioned and within the building code limits, and uniform within the flight.
checklist.why: Uneven risers are the main cause of stair falls and a common plan-check comment.

checklist.item: Nosing profile and projection are shown, with a contrasting stripe where the accessibility code requires one.
checklist.why: Open or sharp nosings catch feet; the stripe is an accessibility requirement.

checklist.item: Connection of stringer to landing and floor structure is shown, with the load path to structure.
checklist.why: A stair that only bears on finish topping fails.

checklist.item: Exterior stairs: treads drain, no surface holds water, and dissimilar metals are separated.
checklist.why: Ponding treads are a slip hazard and rust from the inside.

checklist.item: Tread surface, pan fill and slip resistance are specified.
checklist.why: A smooth tread is a slip hazard.

checklist.item: Clear headroom, landing depth and handrail extensions are referenced to the related details.
checklist.why: These are checked together at plan check.
